title: Positive eigenvalues of the relative SU(2) BFSS Hamiltonian
summary: We prove that the relative $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (2)`$ BFSS Hamiltonian has infinitely many positive eigenvalues tending to infinity, with square-integrable eigenvectors. The operator is defined by closing the gauge-invariant supercharge form. This refutes, at N = 2, the exclusion of normalizable positive-energy states stated in the original BFSS paper.
family_title: Threshold and positive-energy bound states of the BFSS matrix model

review.reason: Analyzes the spectrum of the relative SU(2) BFSS Hamiltonian and its normalizable eigenstates.
